root_cause.text: The device-supplied `num_touch_reports` field is used directly as a loop bound for iterating over the `touch_reports` array without validating it against the array size, enabling an out-of-bounds read when a malicious or faulty device provides a value larger than the fixed array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `min_t(u8, usb->num_touch_reports, ARRAY_SIZE(usb->touch_reports))` and similarly for Bluetooth, clamping the value to the array size. The CVE description states "If it does the loop in dualshock4_parse_report will read off the end of the touch_reports array" and that "up to about 2 KiB" could be read.
